children: Dhebar returns to Hindustan Platinum after senior finance roles at Welspun World and Delta Corp

Hardik Dhebar has been appointed Chief Financial Officer of Hindustan Platinum, according to an announcement shared by the company on LinkedIn. Dhebar has more than 27 years of experience across finance, treasury, capital allocation, investor relations and business performance.
Dhebar joins Hindustan Platinum from Welspun World, where he served as President – Strategic Business & Finance since August 2023, working across structuring, strategy and planning.

Before that, he was Group CFO of Delta from May 2008 to August 2023. During his tenure, he was involved in fundraising activities including a private placement of Rs 285 crore, structured finance of Rs 60 crore from Yes Bank and a qualified institutional placement of Rs 550 crore in 2017.

Dhebar previously served as Group Treasurer at Peninsula Land from April 2005 to May 2008 and as Head of Finance at Hindustan Platinum from December 2004 to April 2005. Earlier, he was Group Treasury Manager at Nicholas Piramal India between June 1997 and March 2004.

Dhebar holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Business Administration with a specialisation in Finance from Welingkar Institute of Management and a Bachelor's degree in Chemistry from the University of Mumbai.
